prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A middle-aged man stands at an outdoor shooting range, viewed from behind at a medium distance. He wears a wide-brimmed hat, a tan tactical vest, and casual shorts, suggesting a relaxed, rural setting. His stance is focused as he aims a shotgun through a wooden shooting stall marked with the number 28. The background features rolling, sun-bleached grassy hills dotted with sparse shrubs and a single tree, under a vast, pale blue sky with a few wispy clouds. The lighting is bright and natural, evoking a hot, late summer afternoon. The color palette is dominated by warm earth tones—yellows, browns, and muted greens—contrasted by the cool blue of the sky. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the man framed by the shooting stall, creating a sense of calm focus and isolation. The overall style is reminiscent of a documentary or slice-of-life photograph, with a slightly faded, vintage quality that enhances the nostalgic, tranquil mood of the rural landscape.
